name: Embrace Your Venom
source:
Marie Boa is a freak. 

Covered in sickening scales, with ugly horns and piercing yellow snake eyes, she has no place among humans. But maybe it doesn't have to be that way- At a crossroads in her life, two women each offer her a path forward. 

It would be so comfortable and easy to just bow her head and accept the chains a subhuman existence deserves. But just as well, there would be such a thrill in finally becoming the monster the world thinks she is. 

These are the only paths afforded to a hideous creature like her.

[From [url=https://breadsteel.itch.io/embrace-your-venom]itch.io[/url]]
